lamina.name: Tempest
lamina.description: Wandering swordsmen who fight up close with the fury of thunder.

recommended.reason: accuracy and crits suit fast strikes

pavilhao.name: Frost
pavilhao.description: Masters of spiritual energy who strike from afar with the ice of the mountains.

lamina.name: Twin Fangs
lamina.description: Two quick strikes on the target, each for 80% of your normal damage.

lamina.name: Lightning Step
lamina.description: Dash to the target (up to 8 tiles, needs a clear path) and hit it for 120% damage.

lamina.name: Blade Storm
lamina.description: Spin your blades to deal 170% damage to all monsters within 2.5 tiles. No target needed.

lamina.name: Guardbreak
lamina.description: Heavy strike for 220% damage that lowers the target's defense by 30% for 6 s.

lamina.name: Blade Flow
lamina.description: Passive: +10% attack speed and +5% crit chance. Grows with your level.

pavilhao.name: Frost Orb
pavilhao.description: Hurl an ice orb that deals 130% of your normal damage. Range 7.

pavilhao.name: Icebloom
pavilhao.description: An ice flower that deals 110% damage and slows the target by 40% for 4 s.

pavilhao.name: Blizzard
pavilhao.description: A blizzard that deals 180% damage to all monsters within 2.5 tiles of the target.

pavilhao.name: Mist Veil
pavilhao.description: Wrap yourself in mist that absorbs damage equal to 25% of max health for 8 s. No target needed.

pavilhao.name: Serene Mind
pavilhao.description: Passive: regenerates 1% of max mana per second outside town. Grows with your level.

inicio.title: Welcome!
inicio.text: Click the ground to move. Click a monster to select it and your character attacks on its own. Tab switches target and Space attacks the nearest one.
inicio.textTouch: Use the joystick on the left to move. Tap a monster to select it and use the Attack button on the right.

portal.title: Portal
portal.text: This portal leads to the forest, where monsters await. Walk into it to cross. If things get hard, you respawn in the village.

primeiro_abate.title: First kill
primeiro_abate.text: Defeating monsters gives experience (XP). Watch the yellow bar on your panel: when it fills, you level up.

primeiro_nivel.title: Level up!
primeiro_nivel.text: You gained free attribute points. Open the panel with the C key (or the Attributes button) and spend them. The recommended attributes for your class are marked, and the "Distribute recommended" button spends everything at once.
primeiro_nivel.textTouch: You gained free attribute points. Tap the Attributes button and spend them. The recommended attributes for your class are marked, and the "Distribute recommended" button spends everything at once.

primeira_morte.title: Back to the village
primeira_morte.text: When you die you return to the village and each equipped item loses 10% of its max durability. Items at 0 durability stop giving bonuses: repair them with the Blacksmith.

primeira_skill.title: New skill!
primeira_skill.text: Use your skills with keys 1 to 4 or by clicking the buttons on the bar below. Each skill costs mana and has a cooldown. The more you use a skill, the higher it levels and the stronger it gets. Open the skills panel with the K key (or the Skills button) to see them all.
primeira_skill.textTouch: Use your skills with the buttons arcing around the Attack button. Each skill costs mana and has a cooldown. Hold a button to see its details. The more you use a skill, the higher it levels and the stronger it gets. The Skills button shows them all.

skill_nivel.title: Skill level up!
skill_nivel.text: Active skills gain experience with every use and get 8% stronger per level (max 10). Passives level up along with your character level. See the progress in the skills panel (K).

primeiro_item.title: You found equipment!
primeiro_item.text: Open the bag with the I key (or the Bag button). The name color shows the rarity: white (common), green (uncommon, 1 bonus) and blue (rare, 2 bonuses). Double-click an item to equip it; hover to see details and compare with what you are wearing.
primeiro_item.textTouch: Open the bag with the Bag button. The name color shows the rarity: white (common), green (uncommon, 1 bonus) and blue (rare, 2 bonuses). Tap an item to see its details and use the Equip button.

primeira_pocao.title: Potions
primeira_pocao.text: Use the Q key for a health potion and E for a mana potion. They heal gradually over 8 seconds, and using another of the same type restarts the effect. Buy more from the Potion Seller in the village.
primeira_pocao.textTouch: Use the potion buttons above the joystick: health (HP) and mana (MP). They heal gradually over 8 seconds, and using another of the same type restarts the effect. Buy more from the Potion Seller in the village.

primeiro_npc.title: Villagers
primeiro_npc.text: Click a villager to walk up to them and open their window. The Blacksmith repairs equipment and the Potion Seller buys and sells items.
primeiro_npc.textTouch: Tap a villager to walk up to them and open their window. The Blacksmith repairs equipment and the Potion Seller buys and sells items.

durabilidade_baixa.title: Gear wearing out
durabilidade_baixa.text: An equipped item is low on durability. Repair it with the Blacksmith in the village. At 0 durability, the item stops giving bonuses (but is not lost).

mochila_cheia.title: Bag full
mochila_cheia.text: The bag has 30 slots. The item stays on the ground for 60 seconds: free up space (sell items to the Potion Seller) and walk over it to pick it up.

primeiro_ouro.title: Gold
primeiro_ouro.text: Monsters drop gold. Use it to repair equipment and buy potions. Items you don't use can be sold to the Potion Seller.

auto_combate.title: Auto-battle
auto_combate.text: The Auto button (or the Z key) makes your character hunt on its own: it picks the nearest monster (up to 2 levels above you), uses your skills and drinks potions. Moving your character pauses auto; press Z again to resume. The gear next to the button opens the menu: choose skills, potion limits and how much to buy in the village.
auto_combate.textTouch: The Auto button makes your character hunt on its own: it picks the nearest monster (up to 2 levels above you), uses your skills and drinks potions. Moving with the joystick pauses auto; tap Auto again to resume. The gear next to it opens the menu: choose skills, potion limits and how much to buy in the village.

ganho_offline.title: Earnings while you are away
ganho_offline.text: Leave Auto on in a hunting map when you close the game and you get XP, gold and items for the time away, at the pace auto measured before you left. It pays 60% up to 12 h, 40% from 12 h to 18 h, 20% from 18 h to 24 h and nothing after that. No deaths, and potions are used at the measured pace.

bandidos.title: Bandits
bandidos.text: Bandit Archers shoot from afar and back off when you get close. Close the distance fast (or use a ranged skill) and kill the archer first. The swordsmen move in groups: attack one and the rest of the gang joins in.

terracota.title: Physical and spiritual defense
terracota.text: Terracotta Warriors have high physical defense and low spiritual defense. Spiritual damage (Frost sect) pierces their armor; physical damage does much less.

byClass.lamina: Tip: Guardbreak lowers the target's defense and makes your physical strikes stronger. Use it before your other skills.
byClass.pavilhao: Tip: you are spiritual, so you have the advantage here.

chefe.title: General's Arena
chefe.text: You entered the Terracotta General's arena. Red circles on the ground show where the area strike will land in 1.5 seconds: get out of the circle before it fills. At half health he summons warriors. Auto-battle does not fight the boss.
